about: Held-out recall eval for a personal-assistant memory retrieval system. Written blind from a spec (no code read). 3 synthetic tenants (Arjun, Meera: individuals in India; Farah: Hyderabad bakery owner) with dated first-person memories, exact facts (verified/reported/inferred with sourceRef), and stale ids superseded by later corrections. 30 cases, 3 per category; required ids must be in retrieved context, forbidden ids must not. Questions are paraphrased to avoid keyword overlap.

memories.text: I'm vegetarian but I do eat eggs, so no meat or fish please.
My usual Sunday breakfast spot is Vaishali on FC Road, I go most weeks.
I'm allergic to cashews, so flag any dish that uses kaju paste or nuts.
My sister Kavya is getting married in Jaipur on the 14th of December.
My manager Rohan wants the quarterly vendor report on the first Monday of every month.
I take Thyronorm 50 for my thyroid every morning on an empty stomach.
My home loan EMI of 42,000 rupees goes out on the 5th of every month.
Dad's sugar readings have been really bad lately, remind me to pick up his strips.
I always want a window seat and I refuse to take red-eye flights.
I reorder Blue Tokai Attikan Estate beans, medium grind, roughly every three weeks.
I visit Dagdusheth Ganpati temple every Tuesday evening after work.
My gym is Cult on Baner Road, I go at 6:30 every morning.
My friend Siddharth borrowed 25,000 from me in March and promised to return it by June.
I'm leading the Pune warehouse migration project, go-live is planned for end of August.
Update: Kavya's wedding has moved to Udaipur, the date is still the same.
We've switched to Third Wave Coffee beans now, Blue Tokai got too pricey.
My wife Nisha's birthday is on 9th July and she absolutely loves orchids.
The doctor increased my thyroid dose, I'm on Thyronorm 75 from this month.
I'm trying to cut down on sugar, suggest desserts without refined sugar.
My Cult membership lapsed, I run at Aundh park in the mornings instead.
Siddharth paid back the whole 25,000 last week, so that's settled.
I watch a Marathi film with my parents every Saturday night.
The warehouse migration go-live slipped to 30th November, Rohan has told the client.
Our house help Sunita comes at 8 and gets 6,000 on the 1st of each month.
I got a traffic challan for jumping a signal and must clear it before the court date.
I always order Nisha's orchids from Ferns N Petals, they deliver on time in Pune.
I need to renew my passport soon, it expires in February next year.
On work trips I stay at Lemon Tree because the company has a corporate rate there.
Dad uses Accu-Chek Instant strips, I buy the pack of 50.
Kavya's mehendi is the day before the wedding and I promised to arrange the dhol band.

Flight: IndiGo 6E-2134 Pune to Udaipur, 12 Dec 2026, window seat 14A, PNR K7QZ2M

memories.text: I don't eat beef or pork, but chicken and fish are completely fine.
My mom in Thrissur has early Parkinson's, I go see her every other weekend.
My husband Varun's Canadian work permit application is still pending, it's stressful.
I like strong filter coffee with no sugar and just a splash of milk.
My design retainer with Kayal Studio pays 1.2 lakh a month.
Varun and I have started seeing a couples counsellor on Thursday evenings.
Anika's school, Choice School, holds the parent-teacher meeting on second Saturdays.
I buy Anika's storybooks from Pai and Co near MG Road.
I go to Guruvayur temple on the first day of every Malayalam month.
I hate long flights, I'd rather take a train if it's under 12 hours.
My Kayal Studio deliverable is the app onboarding redesign, due on 30 April.
Anika is allergic to peanuts, so every snack label needs checking.
I get groceries from Supermart in Panampilly Nagar, they deliver by 6.
We use two packets of Milma toned milk every day.
I owe about 85,000 on my HDFC credit card and I'm paying it off in parts.
Kayal Studio pushed the onboarding redesign deadline to 20 May.
We moved our groceries to BigBasket since Supermart stopped delivering to our area.
Varun's permit finally got approved, he leaves for Toronto in September.
I want an October break in Coorg, ideally a plantation stay.
My college friend Leena lives in Bengaluru, we always meet at Koshy's.
I have veena class with Lakshmi teacher every Wednesday evening.
Kayal revised my retainer, they pay 1.5 lakh a month now.
Mom's neurologist is Dr. Thomas at Amrita, her next review is in August.
We've stopped counselling, Varun and I are separating amicably.
For Coorg I always book through Airbnb rather than hotels.
Anika outgrows her uniform every June, she's on size 28 now.
For Onam we order sadya for six from the Grand Hotel restaurant.
Landlord Mr. Joseph wants 28,000 rent by the 3rd, paid over UPI.
I've hired Adv. Rekha Menon to handle the custody paperwork for Anika.
Anika loves the Malayalam Amar Chitra Katha comics, she has the first ten.

Onboarding redesign deadline: 20 May 2026
Grocery provider: BigBasket
Airbnb: Kaapi Kaadu Plantation Stay, Madikeri, 17-20 Oct 2026
Appointment: Mom's neurology review, Dr. Thomas, Amrita Hospital, 22 Aug 2026 11:00
Recurring: Anika PTM, Choice School, second Saturday monthly 10:00
Varun's departure to Toronto: September 2026
Rent: Rs 28,000 to Mr. Joseph by the 3rd via UPI
Anika: peanut allergy

memories.text: My bakery uses only Amul butter, never margarine, especially in the croissants.
Our flour comes from Ravi Traders in Begum Bazaar, 50 kg every Monday.
My head chef Imran runs the morning bake starting at 4 am.
I fast during Ramzan, so keep my meetings after iftar that month.
CA Pradeep Reddy handles my GST filing, it's due on the 20th.
Instagram is my biggest order channel, I post the new menu every Friday.
I still have about 9 lakh outstanding on my SIDBI business loan.
Swiggy takes 22 percent commission, I'm seriously thinking of leaving them.
My brother Zaid's German student visa got rejected the first time.
I have PCOS and my doctor wants me to stop tasting the sugary batches.
Our boxes come from Pack-It in Kukatpally, the kraft ones with a window.
Imran earns 35,000 a month and he asked me for a raise in April.
Novartis in Hitec City orders 200 cupcakes on the last Friday of each month.
My own favourite drink is strong cardamom tea with no sugar.
We moved flour to Annapurna Mills because Ravi Traders kept delaying deliveries.
I've given Imran a raise to 40,000 starting May.
A neighbour filed a police complaint about smoke from our oven, the hearing is pending.
I want to open a second outlet in Jubilee Hills before Diwali.
We've left Swiggy completely, now it's only Zomato and direct orders.
My daughter Zoya has board exams in March, so no travel for us then.
Novartis bumped their order to 300 cupcakes, still on the last Friday.
Zaid reapplied and got his German visa, he flies to Frankfurt in August.
Packaging now comes from Boxify online since Pack-It raised prices by 18 percent.
The smoke complaint got settled after we installed a chimney filter.
Signed the lease for the second outlet on Road No. 36, rent is 1.8 lakh.
Sana Interiors will do the new outlet's fit-out, their quote was 12 lakh.
My husband Adil checks the accounts on weekends, send him the P&L summary.
Our bestseller is the pistachio kunafa cheesecake, it sells out by 3 pm.
I buy Tahitian vanilla beans from Kerala Spice Co, 100 grams every month.
Mrs. Lalitha orders a 3 kg eggless cake every year for her son's birthday.
Ammi is on dialysis twice a week at Care Hospital now.

exact.text: Flour supplier: Annapurna Mills
Imran's salary: Rs 40,000/month from May 2026
Novartis Hitec City standing order: 300 cupcakes, last Friday monthly
Packaging supplier: Boxify
Order: Mrs. Lalitha, 3 kg eggless cake, deliver 12 Nov 2026 17:00
Lease: second outlet, Road No. 36 Jubilee Hills, Rs 1,80,000/month
Recurring: GST filing with CA Pradeep Reddy, 20th monthly
Delivery channels: Zomato and direct only
Zaid flight to Frankfurt: August 2026
Last order: Kerala Spice Co Tahitian vanilla 100 g, 19 Oct 2026
